super6.race: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Brown Lad Handicap Hurdle (Listed)
super6.comment: Continued theme of run-to-run progression when scoring at Wexford in the spring. Tame first effort at graded level when too lit up in the Persian War on return from further 6 months off. Given a chance by the handicapper following that and could go well if his exuberance is kept in check.

super6.race: Oddschecker Bet Builder Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Consistent type from yard among the winners. Found improvement to get off the mark on reappearance/chase debut at Lingfield this time last year. Didn't see out his race as well on either subsequent start. Bit to find at the weights back hurdling in change of headgear.

finals.comment: Winning hurdler who was brought along steadily over fences last season before failing to get home over a testing 2½m on handicap chase debut at Naas in February. Yard is in good form at present and will be worth noting should the market speak in his favour on return.

finals.race: Cavan Developments Supporting St Marys GAA Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Fascinating Rock gelding. Going well when fell 2 out sole start in points and was undone by a failure to settle when mid-division in bumper at Punchestown in April. Not discounted with attentions now turned to hurdling.

finals.race: Visit oddschecker.com Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Useful handicapper from bang-in-form yard. Made most when winning his sole start in this grade at Newbury last season. Also placed in all 3 handicap starts (outside of top-end events at Cheltenham/Aintree), too, and he makes plenty of appeal on return (could get the run of the race).

Stepped up considerably on NH debut since joining this yard, opening his account under Rules when winning 4-runner bumper at Plumpton (2¼m, good to soft, 5/1) in April. Doesn't have much of a jumping pedigree but has to be respected now hurdling.

Fair Flat winner, though sole win came on debut back in 2023 over 1¼m. Failed to kick on from a promising reappearance at Kempton in May. Hood goes back on for hurdles debut and probably best watched here.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden Hurdle
finals.comment: Crystal Ocean. Dam, lightly raced in bumpers, sister to useful hurdler/fairly useful chaser Cup Final and fairly useful hurdler/useful chaser Asta La Pasta. Easy winner of second start in points. Interesting hurdling debutant for a good yard. Wears tongue tie. Engaged 2.20 Gowran Saturday.

finals.race: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Brown Lad Handicap Hurdle (Listed)
finals.comment: Continued theme of run-to-run progression when scoring at Wexford in the spring. Tame first effort at graded level when too lit up in the Persian War on return from further 6 months off. Given a chance by the handicapper following that and could go well if his exuberance is kept in check.

finals.race: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Brown Lad Handicap Hurdle (Listed)
finals.comment: Hit the frame in top-end handicaps at Cheltenham/Aintree in 2025. On a reduced mark having looked badly out of sorts this year, well beaten behind at Punchestown (100/1) latest. Worth a market check with Mark Walsh on for first time in a while.

finals.race: Tote Guarantee, Never Beaten By SP Brown Lad Handicap Hurdle (Listed)
finals.comment: Won the Kim Muir at Cheltenham in 2024/25. Emerged with credit when mid-field in this year's renewal. This presumably a pipe-opener with a return to fences in mind.

Dual winner on the Flat who did well over hurdles for Toby Lawes in 2024/25, winning twice, though shaped as if needing further than this on handicap bow over C&D final start. Likely to find a few too sharp returning from a long absence.

French bumper winner who created a good impression when winning C&D juvenile hurdle on debut for this yard last winter. Well held at a higher level since, however, and mark high enough even if back to his best.

finals.race: Oddschecker Bet Builder Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Made a promising start to his hurdling career last season, finishing close second in a Newcastle novice on final start for Iain Jardine in April. Has since joined an outstanding yard and is fancied to go one better on handicap debut.

finals.race: Oddschecker Bet Builder Novices' Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Consistent type from yard among the winners. Found improvement to get off the mark on reappearance/chase debut at Lingfield this time last year. Didn't see out his race as well on either subsequent start. Bit to find at the weights back hurdling in change of headgear.

finals.race: Bet With Tote On Racing & Sports Irish EBF Mares (Pro/Am) Flat Race
finals.comment: Policy Maker filly. Half-sister to 3 winners, including useful hurdle/smart chase winner Zero Ten (2m-2½m winner) and fairly useful hurdler All For Rachel (2½m/21f winner). Dam (b82) runner-up in bumper. Merits consideration with yard going well.
